**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** preamble (no choice-of-law), § 11 "SEVERABILITY; GOVERNING LAW" (p0043 — Arizona law), and § 19 (p0053/p0056 — mandatory binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules, courts limited to confirming the award).
- **Why it fails fallback:** Arizona is outside the accepted list, and the dispute forum is arbitration rather than the corresponding courts, so neither fallback element is met.
- **Smallest complete cure (preferred level, 3 ops):** swap only the jurisdiction words to New York law; convert the § 19 dispute mechanic to exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County; rename the § 19 heading to "Dispute Resolution" so no retained arbitration reference dangles. Signature block, severability language, and all unrelated text preserved verbatim; minimality gate returned ok:true.
